I loaded the monthly history, treated sales as monthly seasonal, and used a small ensemble because there are only three January observations and future promo intensity is unknown. For the promo-based model, I imputed 2026-01 promo intensity as the historical January average.

```python
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters import ExponentialSmoothing
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
from scipy.stats import norm

# df loaded from the CSV supplied in the prompt
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(dict(year=df.period_year, month=df.period_month, day=1))
df = df.set_index("date").asfreq("MS")
df["t"] = np.arange(len(df))
df["log_sales"] = np.log(df["sales_units"])
df["promo_imp"] = df["promo_intensity"].fillna(df["promo_intensity"].mean())

future = pd.DataFrame({
    "period_year": [2026],
    "period_month": [1],
    "t": [len(df)],
    "promo_intensity": [df.loc[df.period_month == 1, "promo_intensity"].mean()]
})
future["promo_imp"] = future["promo_intensity"]

# 1) ETS seasonal
ets = ExponentialSmoothing(
    df.sales_units, trend=None, seasonal="mul",
    seasonal_periods=12, initialization_method="estimated"
).fit()
ets_fc = ets.forecast(1).iloc[0]

# 2) OLS log-sales with month seasonality + trend
ols = smf.ols("log_sales ~ t + C(period_month)", data=df.reset_index()).fit()
ols_fc = np.exp(ols.get_prediction(future).summary_frame(alpha=0.20)["mean"].iloc[0])

# 3) OLS log-sales with month seasonality + trend + imputed promo
ols_promo = smf.ols("log_sales ~ t + C(period_month) + promo_imp", data=df.reset_index()).fit()
ols_promo_fc = np.exp(ols_promo.get_prediction(future).summary_frame(alpha=0.20)["mean"].iloc[0])

# 4) Seasonal random-walk SARIMA on log-sales
sar = SARIMAX(
    np.log(df.sales_units), order=(0,0,0), seasonal_order=(0,1,0,12),
    enforce_stationarity=False, enforce_invertibility=False
).fit(disp=False)
sar_fc = np.exp(sar.get_forecast(1).predicted_mean.iloc[0])

# 5) January-only trend
jan = df[df.period_month == 1]
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(jan.period_year, jan.sales_units, 1)
jan_trend_fc = slope * 2026 + intercept

forecasts = np.array([ets_fc, ols_fc, ols_promo_fc, sar_fc, jan_trend_fc])
forecast = forecasts.mean()
forecast
```
